Common Questions

Know what to expect before we start.

Clear answers about pricing, revisions, timelines, and launching your website.

What does the $500 starting package include?
A custom one-page website with mobile and desktop layouts, core business sections, calls to action, basic SEO and sharing setup, two revision rounds, and launch assistance. Extra pages, advanced forms, paid software, custom photography, and complex systems are quoted separately.
How long does a website usually take?
A focused one-page website can often be completed within one to three weeks after the required content is received. The final schedule depends on project size, response time, revisions, and special features.
Is a deposit required?
Yes. Paid projects begin after the agreed scope is documented and a 50% deposit is received. The remaining balance is due before final transfer or launch.
Who pays for the domain and hosting?
The client owns and pays for the domain, hosting, and any premium services. I can help connect everything and confirm that the finished website works correctly.
Can you redesign an existing website?
Yes. I can modernize the layout, improve mobile usability, reorganize the information, strengthen calls to action, and preserve familiar business content where appropriate.
Do you work only with Central Florida businesses?
Central Florida is the main service area, but remote projects can also be handled through text, email, shared files, and online previews.
